requirements.statement: A stable binding profile, action catalog and context stack replace all parallel hard-coded gameplay, HUD and shell input paths.
acceptance: Rebinding persists, conflicts fail deterministically and contexts prevent input leakage.
Client physical input and headless command input preserve authoritative receipts.

requirements.statement: Versioned package defaults and a user binding profile compile into one deterministic effective action map.
acceptance: Profiles round-trip canonically, preserve unknown actions, persist across restart and reject normalized same-context conflicts.
Exactly one lock-selected input-actions provider supplies production defaults without host include or fallback catalogs.

requirements.statement: One active input context stack owns gameplay suppression, cursor, focus and pressed-state propagation for every client surface.
acceptance: Pause, settings, inventory and workbench prevent gameplay leakage while the documented hotbar allowlist still works.
Context transitions leave no stuck or replayed input and preserve the native Esc safety path.

requirements.statement: Gameplay, HUD and shell consume compiled logical actions rather than private physical-key mappings.
acceptance: Production gameplay, HUD and shell paths contain no business-action ButtonInput or hard-coded fallback maps.
Keyboard, mouse and standard gamepad logical streams preserve client/headless authoritative receipt parity.
